The Hengegates and Keystaffs of Ancient Archaia

During the Golden Age of Archaia, the Archaians erected stone teleportation circles—Hengegates—across the Northern Reaches. Only magic-users or illusionists may wield an Archaian Keystaff. Grand Magus Kelda of the Seven-Stars and Muirron the Magician in Eastdale will pay 100 to 1,000 gp for verified lore regarding henge magic.

Required Components (In Exact Order)

  1. Ebon Staff: 6-foot black metal shaft with three ring indentations and a triangular headpiece socket.
  2. Ring 1 — Ring of Embarkation: Made of Archinium (800 gp). Holds 3 location runes; must be aligned with the indicator arrow to match the origin Hengegate.
  3. Ring 2 — Ring of Destination: Made of Platinum (500 gp). Holds 3 location runes; must be aligned with the indicator arrow to match the target Hengegate.
  4. Ring 3 — Power Ring: Unlocks teleportation and grants combat spells (Volcanic Conflagration, Icy Glaciate, or Archomancy).
  5. Headpiece: Inserted into the top triangular slot; governs teleportation frequency and remaining charges.

Hengegate Location Runes

Rune Code Hengegate Location
HG1Dragon's Teeth Henge (The Forbidden Zone)
HG2Southwestern Gate (Archaia)
HG3Southeastern Gate (Archaia)
HG4The Great Henge (Archaia)
HG5Northern Gate (Archaia)
HG6Hell-Fire Furnace
HG7Darkwood Forest (Location Unknown)
HG8The Secret Shrine of Zorgon (Duchy of Aerik)
HG9Barrowmaze (#11 The Standing Stone of the Chosen)

Note: Destroyed destinations are marked by Broken Runes and fail to operate if selected.

Keystaff Secondary Uses (Henge Bowls)

Every Hengegate features stone statues or monolith extensions holding a copper bowl. Holding a fully assembled Keystaff over a bowl filled with specific materials triggers minor dweomers—and grants a 15% chance (once per day per location) to restore +1 teleportation charge to the attached Headpiece:

Material in Bowl Dweomer Effect
WaterDisplays a visual image of the target destination Hengegate on the water's surface.
MilkProjects two-way sound to and from the target Hengegate.
SandTeleports small hand-sized items placed atop the sand to the destination Hengegate.
Iron FilingsCauses the Keystaff to physically point toward the selected destination.
Wood ChipsIgnites a fire immediately.
BloodTransmits any spell cast into the bowl directly to the target destination.
OilAnimates the adjacent stone statue as a Greater Archaian Sentinel.
SoilRestores a small creature (under 1 HD) to life.

Crossing the Streams ([[/r 1d10]])

Carrying a disassembled second Keystaff through a Hengegate is safe. However, carrying more than one fully assembled Keystaff through an active Hengegate triggers a catastrophic anomaly (roll [[/r 1d10]]):

  1. Nothing happens.
  2. Only living beings pass through; all inanimate gear and clothing remain behind.
  3. Random alignment change.
  4. Teleported directly in front of a random Archon of the Trium ([[/r 1d3]]).
  5. Transported to a random Hengegate.
  6. An angry Balor demon is summoned onto the dais.
  7. Transported to a random wilderness hex on the Region Map.
  8. Transported to a random dungeon location in Archaia ([[/r 1d75]]).
  9. A twisted mound of petrified flesh, organs, and [[/r 1d6]] gemstones materializes.
  10. All travelers suffer [[/r 1d6]] damage per character level.
